text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time once again for the annual
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm back and rarin' to go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What should we do first? Split some

watermelons? Shoot some fireworks? Or
how
'bout a barbeque?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh—that ain't all, of course! Training's
still top
priority!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll need some hardcore prep before I
take on the
Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So c'mon, Trainer! Let's train our way to
victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, summer camp kicks off.
